producerDescription:
Watch Blondshell and Producer Yves Rothman chat about recording her self-titled debut album, out now https://blondshell.lnk.to/blondshell

Set a reminder to join for the livestream at 9:30am PT on May 16, with the release of the “Salad” video to follow at 10am PT!  https://blondshell.lnk.to/salad-video
